SELECT S.*, C.KOR AS STORE_TYPE FROM STORE S LEFT JOIN CODE C ON S.S_CATEGORY = C.VALUE WHERE TYPE = 'S_CATEGORY' AND lat BETWEEN #{swLat} AND #{neLat} -- 남쪽 위도와 북쪽 위도 사이 AND lng BETWEEN #{swLng} AND #{neLng} -- 서쪽 경도와 동쪽 경도 사이
AND C.KOR = #{storeType}

SELECT S.STORE_NO, STORE_NAME, S_ADDR, S_STATUS, LAT, LNG, C.KOR AS STORE_TYPE, S_CONTENTS FROM STORE S LEFT JOIN CODE C ON S.S_CATEGORY = C.VALUE LEFT JOIN STORE_DETAIL D ON S.STORE_NO = D.STORE_NO WHERE TYPE = 'S_CATEGORY' AND S.STORE_NO = #{storeNo}
SELECT S.STORE_NO, STORE_NAME, MENU_NAME, MENU_PRICE, M_STATUS FROM STORE S LEFT JOIN STORE_MENU M ON S.STORE_NO = M.STORE_NO WHERE M_STATUS = 'Y' AND S.STORE_NO = #{storeNo}
SELECT STORE_NO, FILE_NO, FILE_PATH, FILE_NAME, ORIGIN_NAME, IS_MAIN FROM STORE_FILE WHERE STORE_NO = #{storeNo} ORDER BY IS_MAIN DESC, FILE_NO ASC

SELECT SLOT_NO, STORE_NO, SLOT_DATE, DATE_FORMAT(SLOT_TIME, '%H:%i') AS SLOT_TIME, CAPACITY, CUR_COUNT, IS_AVAILABLE FROM RSV_SLOT WHERE STORE_NO = #{storeNo} AND SLOT_DATE = #{targetDate} ORDER BY SLOT_TIME ASC
